About Our Church

Faith • Grace • Fellowship

Welcome to Hour Of Grace

We are a Christian church community committed to worship, prayer, biblical teaching and serving people with love. Everyone is welcome to fellowship with us and grow in faith.


Our mission: To share the Gospel, build strong believers and serve our community through the grace of God.
